title: A new method for constructing a compact and non SI-compact space
summary: In this paper, we provide a new method for constructing a compact and non SI-compact space and thus give a new answer for the question posed by Zhao and Ho. Using this method, we find a countable compact space which fails to be SI-compact. As a corollary, some new non sober frames are obtained and thus we give a new answer for a question raised by A.Jung.
